title: Adoption Acceleration Compact Playbook (30/60/90)
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact, operational-first 30/60/90 playbook intended for low-to-medium touch customers who have completed technical onboarding but need a structured adoption acceleration plan. The objective is to create predictable milestones, early risk signals, and a renewal-ready QBR stub they can be shown at month 3.

Context + assumptions:
- Target customer: SMB to mid-market, single-product integration of Redwood Hosted API (text gen + embeddings).
- They completed initial integration and sample traffic is present (>= 200 API calls/day or 10k tokens/day).
- Goal: reach product-led value (1–2 core features live) and establish usage patterns to justify renewal/expansion.
- This doc is intentionally compact (one page per phase) for CSMs running 3–10 accounts.

Success metrics (pick 2 primary, 3 secondary):
- Primary: active request rate (DAU or weekly active integrator) increased by +40% vs baseline; feature adoption: primary API route now handles >= 30% of total customer traffic.
- Secondary: median latency <= target (as defined in contract), embedding usage growth, first-dollar ROI signal (customer internal metric), documented internal case studies.
- Renewal signal: consistent weekly growth for 4 consecutive weeks OR clear product usage tied to core KPI.

Quick risk score (CSM use):
- Green: >50% of top-3 routes have healthy traffic and no open P1/P2 tickets.
- Yellow: sporadic traffic, 1–2 unresolved P2 tickets, or declining token growth month-over-month.
- Red: integration regressions, major latency spikes, or requests dropped due to rate limits/quotas.

30-day (stabilize + value surfacing)
- Goal: Verify integration stability and surface a tangible value metric for the customer team.
- Actions:
  - Week 1: run health check (integration checklist below) and schedule 30m sync with engineering lead.
  - Week 2: instrument one lightweight evaluation: "happy-path" prompt set that maps to a customer outcome (e.g., 50 responses checked for correctness).
  - Week 3: enable simple observability: share token breakdown + per-route latency with customer; highlight one clear improvement area (caching suggestion or prompt tweak).
  - Week 4: send a short "first-value report" (1 page) with: current traffic baseline, quick wins, and next-phase plan.
- Deliverables: health-check doc, sample eval results, first-value report.

60-day (optimize + expand usage)
- Goal: Remove friction, expand to one adjacent use-case, and document quality baselines.
- Actions:
  - Week 5–6: implement 1 optimization from Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching suggestion or KV cache suggestion). Track cost delta.
  - Week 7: pilot second route (e.g., embeddings for search rerank) with lightweight A/B: monitor relevance metrics for 2 weeks.
  - Week 8: schedule 45m adoption workshop with product owners to map internal KPIs to API usage.
- Deliverables: optimization changelog, A/B results summary, workshop notes and owners for next steps.

90-day (scale + renewal prep)
- Goal: Reach renewal-ready status with documented business value and a QBR one-pager.
- Actions:
  - Week 9–10: consolidate metric history (30-day and 60-day) into a one-page QBR: usage trends, error/latency summary, cost per 1k tokens, feature adoption chart.
  - Week 11: identify champions and create an internal case snippet (quote + short ROI bullet).
  - Week 12: run renewal-risk review with AE and CSM: score account (renewal probability) and agree next steps (expansion, discount, technical work).
- Deliverables: QBR one-pager, renewal recommendation, customer testimonial snippet.

Handoff / integration health checklist (quick, binary)
- API keys validated and rotated within past 90 days? (yes/no)
- Webhooks/callbacks (if used) have retry/backoff and alerting?
- Error rate <1% for successful response codes?
- Latency P50/P90 within contract SLO?
- Rate limit warnings observed? (if yes, list route)
- Embeddings index refresh cadence documented?

Renewal tracker (compact schema for CSM quick view)
- Renewal date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
- Current ARR (or committed $): [$]
- Usage vs committed: [percent]
- Primary expansion opps: [list product areas]
- Open technical risks: [short bullets]
- Renewal recommendation: [green/yellow/red + rationale]

QBR one-pager template (CSM editable)
- Header: customer, CSM, AE, renewal date
- Topline: 30/60/90 snapshot (bullets)
- Metrics: usage chart (tokens/day), route adoption %, latency summary, error rate
- Wins: 2–3 bullets of product impact
- Risks & requests: 1–2 bullets (asks of product/infra)
- Next steps & owners

Low-touch comms play (email snippets)
- 30-day email (to eng lead): short intro + health check summary + one ask.
- 60-day invite (to product owner): invite to 45m workshop with suggested agenda.
- 90-day QBR send: attach QBR one-pager + proposed renewal next-step options.

Mini-templates (copy/paste)
- 30-day subject: "Redwood: quick health & one suggestion (30-day)"
- 30-day body: "Hi <name>, quick note — integration looks stable on our side. Attached is a 1-page health check and one small prompt suggestion that reduced irrelevant responses in our sample by ~18%. Can we sync 30m next week? — Maya"
- 60-day invite subject: "Workshop: prioritize feature adoption and KPIs"
- 60-day body: "Hi <name>, we'd like to run a 45m workshop to map your top 3 KPIs to the routes you're calling today and agree a 60-day pilot for an adjacent use case. Proposed times: <slots>. — Samir"

Operational notes / TODOs (CSM use)
- [ ] Attach the health-check doc to the customer folder (link).
- [ ] Create a short eval suite in GH for the happy-path prompts. (owner: Eng-SE)
- [ ] Add account to weekly low-touch review board if risk=yellow or red.
- [ ] If optimization reduces cost >12% escalate to AE for potential pricing discussion.

Notes to self (rough):
- Try a condensed "first-value report" template that is <200 words + 2 charts — customers respond better than long decks.
- For mid-market, prioritize embedding adoption early (search relevancy sells).
- Watch for token spikes during product demos (often hides latent bugs).

Appendix: examples of signals to escalate to SRE/Product quickly:
- Repeated 5xx spikes correlated with a new model rollout or tenant change.
- Degraded P90 with no corresponding token length change (possible regression in runtime kernels).
- Sudden drop in embedding similarity scores after a quantization change.

Change log:
- 2025-11-12: initial draft (Maya)
- 2026-01-10: added low-touch email snippets (Samir)
- 2026-02-20: tightened renewal tracker fields and added QBR template (Elena)

Unresolved questions:
- Do we ALWAYS require a 45m workshop at 60d or can we do a 30m executive summary for customers who push back? (note: pilot with 30m as an option)
- Should we include a standard shared dashboard link for all low-touch accounts? (ops cost concern)

End of doc.
